receipts.use: open any pull request that touches `docs/`, README, a workflow, the catalogue or the drill catalogue; the `prose` check comments on the offending line with the word to use.

receipts.use: merge after idp#1013; the :41 otto-parity run grades the new rows.

receipts.title: fix: every entity in the portal was owned by a team that existed nowhere
receipts.use: merge. Flux reconciles the backstage Kustomization, the `org-catalog` ConfigMap lands, the pod picks the new projected file up and the catalogue re-reads its locations.

receipts.title: fix: five portal routes answered 404 and no state border met contrast
receipts.use: merge, then open the portal and click the five menu entries that used to 404.

receipts.title: platform: point the shop at the build that has the pack pictures
receipts.use: merge; Flux reconciles `clusters/oke/edge.yaml` and the prospector Kustomization rolls store-web and store-api. The drill then runs on the push to main and hourly after it.

receipts.title: fix: the cluster takes what git holds — appID substitutes as a string, wedged Helm releases rebuild from git
receipts.use: merge; Flux reconciles — hermes-agent and mcp admit their generators, tailscale-operator remediates instead of sitting Failed.

receipts.title: The otto-parity drill grades git and gh from inside the pod
receipts.use: `gh workflow run oke-check.yml -R chidionyema/idp -f mode=break-glass -f playbook=otto-parity`, or wait for the scheduled otto-parity run.

receipts.title: dispatch: prove a break-glass playbook on its branch before it is merged
receipts.use: `OKE_REF=my-branch bin/idp-oke-dispatch diagnose` runs that branch's playbooks against the cluster. Plain `bin/idp-oke-dispatch diagnose` is unchanged.

receipts.title: The kyverno judge grades the Pod admission grades, not only the Deployment
receipts.use: `bin/idp-kyverno-render platform/tailscale`, and the kyverno rung of `bin/idp-ci` on every PR.

receipts.title: Otto's GitHub token is minted in-cluster, day 0 (idp#852 root)
receipts.use: merge; Flux reconciles hermes-agent and mcp; Otto's next `gh auth status` from Telegram signs in.
